content:
I am working on Lean code for locally convex spaces and my LLM (Claude in this instance) reports a problem with Mathlib's WeakBilin. The problem is described and illustrated in the attached file WeakBilinUnification.lean and it may be exhibited via the command lake env lean WeakBilinUnification.lean. Synopsis:

WeakBilin B is a def synonym of E. Mathlib derives AddCommMonoid (WeakBilin B) and
Module 𝕝 (WeakBilin B) directly and declares AddCommGroup (WeakBilin B) separately. Take a
lemma that assumes [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 F] and apply it, with F implicit, to a bundled
linear map into WeakBilin D, where the type underlying WeakBilin D is a space of linear maps
(Module.Dual 𝕜 E below, StrongDual 𝕜 X in section 2). Elaboration fails, and it takes about a
million heartbeats to fail. It succeeds at once if

  • the codomain F is given explicitly, or
  • the lemma assumes only [AddCommMonoid F], or
  • the type underlying the synonym is an abstract type with an AddCommGroup instance.

WeakBilinUnification.lean
